_comment: Curated physical features of the commute route (km_from_home frame). Sources: pooled p90-speed detection cross-confirmed by both directions + Suryanarayan's ground truth (2026-08-19). Speed-breaker coords are medians of the detected dip locations. broken_stretches/hard_corners are stored for analysis use but not drawn on the map.

speed_breakers.note: the 'hat over a hat' double-stacked breaker; deepest dip in both directions inside the broken stretch
double breaker, first hump; 65->26 km/h forced drop

broken_stretches.note: broken surface the whole way (p90 ceiling ~44 vs 54-62 elsewhere); contains the 3.2 km breaker and ends at the 3.8 km hard corner
super broken patch with double 90-degree bend (bends at ~7.09 and ~7.43)
super broken patch; unprotected junction at 7.8; stall slope hummock (~8 m rise, 5-6% grade) at 7.5-7.6
